text: どんなに　つよい　ポケモンを　てに　いれても　うまく　あつかえなきゃ　ぜんぜん　いみ　ないぜ！

structure.jp: どんなに　つよい　ポケモンを　てに　いれても
structure.en: no matter how strong a Pokémon you get

structure.jp: うまく　あつかえなきゃ
structure.en: if you can't handle it well

structure.jp: ぜんぜん　いみ　ないぜ！

patterns.name: どんなに〜ても
patterns.span: どんなに　つよい　ポケモンを　てに　いれても
patterns.explanation: どんなに with ても later on means 'no matter how much'. どんなに　つよい　ポケモンを　てに　いれても = 'no matter how strong a Pokémon you get'.

patterns.name: 〜なければ
patterns.explanation: なきゃ is the casual short form of なければ, 'if not'. It sits on あつかえる, 'can handle'. あつかえなきゃ = 'if you can't handle it'.

patterns.name: 〜ぜ
patterns.explanation: ぜ at the end is rough, boyish emphasis. いみ　ないぜ = 'there's no point, I tell you!'.
